overall_reason: A brand-guidelines site whose identity palette comes in paired tokens (--color--identity--blue with --color--identity--on-purple and other on-colours); the sparse page shows few values, reused, with one near pair in spacing and one in title sizes.

score.reason: T-VALUE-INVENTORY passes: each identity tile carries one palette colour; T-DRIFT-PAIRS finds a 23 against 24px padding and 33.5 against 36px titles (TOK-010).

findings.evidence: The strategy tile is padded 23px (32 elements, #tilestrategy) while the outro uses 24 and 22px for the same kind of block padding (values.1440.spacing near_duplicates 23/24).
findings.why: Three paddings 1px apart do one job.

findings.evidence: Tile titles are 33.5px and the nav button title 36px (values.1440.font_size near_duplicates 33.5/36, 7% apart), both in the display face.
findings.after: One title size token for tiles and nav buttons
findings.why: Two title sizes 7% apart read as the same level set twice.

strengths: The identity palette is named by role with a matching on-colour for each fill (--color--identity--on-purple, --on-yellow, --on-cyan, --on-red, --on-green, --on-orange), so every tile pairs text with its fill.
Layout runs on named column tokens (--body-col-1-left to --body-col-12-right) instead of typed offsets.
One radius (8px) and no shadows, so there is no card family to drift.
not_investigated: inline style attributes: the DOM records computed styles only
token source files behind the shipped CSS (Sass, JSON tokens, Figma variables): only the shipped CSS was read
states the capture did not open (hover, focus, open menus): their values are not in the table

the main Webflow stylesheet was cross-origin and unreadable; the 14 tokens referenced without a readable declaration (--accent--tab, --text--base, the identity colours) are probably declared there, so they are unknown, not missing
the page's imagery and identity tiles hold most of the content; their artwork was not judged
